project.name: Lonora
project.summary: Lonora is an always-on AI trading assistant. You chat with AI agents in a web or phone app; the agents keep working on the server even after you close it, can watch markets and place trades through a broker, and talk back by text or voice. A Python (FastAPI) server answers the apps and a background worker runs the agents.

flows.title: You send a message to an agent

steps.note: You type a message to one of your agents.
The server receives it and starts a run.
The run is handed to the always-on worker so it continues even if you close the app.
The agent engine runs the agent's reasoning loop.
It calls an outside AI model provider to think.
The agent uses tools — search, charts, trading — as it needs them, and the reply streams back to you.
The agent decides to act on the market.
Trading checks the on/off and emergency-stop controls, then sends the order.
MetaApi places it with the real or imported-simulation account.

flows.title: You talk to an agent by voice

steps.note: You open voice in the app.
A live connection opens for the call.
The voice path connects the call to the agent.
It uses a live voice model, routed to the same agent and tools.
